faqs.question: How do I know this keyboard fits my laptop?
faqs.answer: This fits the HP EliteBook 840 G3, 840 G4, 745 G3 and 745 G4, which share the same chassis. If you're unsure of your exact model, send us a photo of the sticker under your laptop on WhatsApp and we'll confirm.

faqs.question: Is it backlit?
faqs.answer: Yes, this version includes backlighting to match the original. We also stock a non-backlit version for this series.
